_comment: Scripted outcome of the outbound Stock-Team validation call (spec Flow 7), keyed by booking_id. Used by POST /api/v1/calls/stock-team when no live stock verification report exists. stock_status: confirmed (booking will be honoured) | unavailable (stock team could not confirm / unreachable).

601003.notes: Stock team validated inventory; booking will be honoured at check-in.

601011.notes: Stock team unreachable; no confirmation available.

601004.notes: Stock team confirmed genuine overbooking; recommend shift.

601007.notes: Property blocked for maintenance; recommend shift.

601010.notes: No resolution with property on pricing; recommend shift.
